preconditions.description: The root of the binary tree is not None.
The target is an integer within the range [1, 10000].

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node.data, int) and 1 <= node.data <= 10000 for node in tree_nodes(root))
preconditions.description: All node data values in the tree are integers within the range [1, 10000].

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value in tree_values(root) and is_mirror_position(root, target, return_value))
postconditions.description: The return value is either -1 (if no mirror exists) or the value of a node that exists in the tree and is at the mirror position of the target node.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if not exists_node_with_value(root, target) else (return_value != -1 if exists_mirror(root, target) else return_value == -1)
postconditions.description: If the target node does not exist in the tree, return -1. If the target exists but has no mirror (e.g., root or missing counterpart), return -1. Otherwise, return the mirror node's value.
